message.text: This looks like the generic scheduler library itself rather than an actual registration of a database-cleanup job, so I should check if it's actually wired up somewhere in the app, like the server, to run that job.

No usages outside the scheduler package itself, meaning it's just a library not wired into any real "database-cleanup" job—the example mentioning cleanup at 2 AM is only documentation, not an active registration. I should check elsewhere in cmd/ or server/ for any actual cron or db vacuum job that's really in use.

There's no actual nightly database-cleanup job — the scheduler package is just a generic library, and the "Cleanup old data every night at 2 AM" text is merely an illustrative comment in example_test.go, not a real job. I should look at that example directly so I can cite it accurately.
